The [[Gentik]] '''Mark I EM System''' was part of the espionage package that the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] placed into modified [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droids]] that allowed them to function as effective [[Spy/Legends|spies]].
